193:     def _translate_filters(

195:             filters: "Iterable[dict[str, Any]]",

207:         ]

210: 
211:         [[[or_group_1->key_1, or_group_1->operator_1, or_group_1->value_1],
212:           ...
213:           [or_group_1->key_m, or_group_1->operator_m, or_group_1->value_m]
214:          ],
215:          ...
216:          [[or_group_n->key_1, or_group_n->operator_1, or_group_n->value_1],
217:           ...
218:           [or_group_n->key_m, or_group_n->operator_m, or_group_n->value_m]
219:          ]
220:         ]
221: 
222:         replacing all filter operator suffixes with python equivalents using the LUT, <OPERATORS_CONVERSION_LUT>, and
223:         coercing all filter words to their corresponding <model_class> attribute.

225:         Typecasting of values is also attempted.

227:         :param filters: The filters to translate.

229:         :param strict_coerce: Enforce that keywords must be coercible to a model attribute.
230:         :returns: The list of translated filters, and the set of mandatory model attributes to be used in the filter query.

239:         mandatory_model_attributes = set()

255:                         key_no_suffix = ast.literal_eval(key_tokenised[0])

272:                     (key_no_suffix, OPERATORS_CONVERSION_LUT.get(oper), value))
